title: Voice Chat: every feature a plugin with a toggle

chat.text: Each Voice Chat feature (barge-in, reply wait, thinking cue, read-aloud, tap to pause, replay, send cursor) becomes a class you can switch on and off from the settings panel, live. Plan first, then the plugin base and the panel, then one feature per merge.

message.text: The plan is written: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/dictate-plugins/plan.md. Each feature becomes a class you switch on or off from a new Features list at the top of the gear panel, and the change takes effect without a reload. A link like ?vc.thinking-cue.on=0 tries a change for one page load without saving it. All 29 existing gear settings turned out to work. Being built now: the plugin base, the Features list, and the thinking cue as the first plugin.
